overrides.scope: monster ability score tables (HTML <table> cells inside stat blocks)
overrides.observed: OCR artifact: numeral 1 rendered as 'I' (9 cells) and 11 rendered as 'II' (23 cells), e.g. Lemure CON/INT/WIS.
overrides.proposed: When parsing typed ability values only, map a standalone token 'I' -> 1 and 'II' -> 11 (optionally signed for modifier/save cells). Verbatim table cells and rulesText are NOT altered.
overrides.rationale: The tokens appear exclusively where an integer ability score, modifier, or save bonus is required; no roman numerals are otherwise used in SRD stat tables. Without the mapping, 23 of 332 monsters would lack typed ability fields.

overrides.observed: PDF conversion renders some ability labels as LaTeX markup, e.g. '$\mathbf{S_{TR}}$' (Bandit, Commoner) and '$\mathbf{STR}$' (Brass Dragon Wyrmling).
overrides.proposed: Strip the LaTeX wrapper to the plain three-letter ability label before typed parsing.
overrides.rationale: Pure formatting artifact; the underlying labels are unambiguous.

overrides.observed: Some cells glue label and score without a space or with wrong case, e.g. 'CON25', 'CHA23' (Adult Red Dragon), 'Con22' (Adult White Dragon).
overrides.proposed: Split into label + integer score for typed parsing; the mod/save cells lost in the same table rows stay omitted rather than invented.
overrides.rationale: Row truncation in the PDF conversion; scores are unambiguous, missing values must not be fabricated.

overrides.observed: A few stat blocks join the CR line onto the Languages line (e.g. Young Gold Dragon: 'Languages Common, Draconic CR 10 (XP 5,900; PB +4)'), and White Dragon Wyrmling prints '450 XP' instead of 'XP 450'.
overrides.proposed: Match the CR expression at a word boundary anywhere in the stat text and accept both XP orderings for typed fields.
overrides.rationale: Line-join artifacts; the CR grammar is otherwise unambiguous.

overrides.observed: 28 stat blocks have truncated rows where a score, modifier, or save cell is absent from the source entirely (e.g. Goat CON row reads 'CON', '+0'; several dragons lose the CON and CHA columns).
overrides.proposed: No repair: typed ability entries are omitted where the source value is missing. Verbatim table text is preserved in the corresponding Table/rulesText content.
overrides.rationale: Never invent missing values; the printed SRD is the only authority for what the value should be.

overrides.scope: equipment and item tables ('Id6' for '1d6', etc.)
overrides.observed: OCR artifact: leading '1' in dice expressions rendered as capital 'I' in several HTML tables (e.g. the Weapons table) and in magic item category examples ('+I Longsword').
overrides.proposed: No typed dice fields are derived from these cells in v1; values are preserved verbatim. Revisit when equipment gains a typed catalog.
overrides.rationale: Prose fidelity: no structured field currently depends on these cells, so no normalization is performed.
